ClassificationEntry.description:
Represents a single entry for classifying an entity to a vocabulary term

These are used to create the final classification for an entity. This is done by
ordering the classification entries based on their scores, with higher scores indicating greater confidence.

The `last_updated` field should be used as a tie-breaker when scores are equal, with later timestamps
taking precedence.

For entries where the `Vocabulary` is single, the highest scoring entry should be selected as the final classification.

For entries where the `Vocabulary` allows multiple entries, all entries with sufficiently high scores
should be considered for the final classification.

If a classification entry is marked with `exclude=True`, all entries for that term with a lower score
should be disregarded when determining the final classification.

term.description: The vocabulary term for this classification entry
term.title: Term

score.description: The confidence score for this classification entry. Higher values indicate greater confidence.
score.title: Score

exclude.description: Indicates whether this classification entry indicates that the term should be excluded from consideration. False means that this is a positive result for the classification
exclude.title: Exclude

last_updated.description: The timestamp of the last update for this classification entry
last_updated.title: Last Updated

ClassificationEntry.title: ClassificationEntry
